robots.name: Robot Arm
robots.description: 5-DOF robot arm — keyboard & slider control, pick-and-place demo, wave, scan presets. Add objects to the scene.

robots.name: Walking Robot
robots.description: Bipedal robot learning to walk — adjust stride, speed, hip offset, knee bend. Push to disturb balance.

robots.name: Mars Rover
robots.description: Drive a 6-wheeled rover across Mars terrain — WASD controls, collect samples, avoid rocks and craters. Auto-explore mode.

robots.name: Maze Solver
robots.description: Robot navigates random mazes — compare Wall Following vs A* vs BFS algorithms side by side.

robots.name: Inverted Pendulum
robots.description: Classic control systems demo — PID controller balances a pendulum on a cart. Tune gains, push to disturb.

robots.name: Bouncing Ball
robots.description: 3D physics sim — Rapier.js rigid bodies, 5 gravity modes (Earth to Zero-G), orbit camera.

robots.name: Line Follower
robots.description: PID-controlled robot following a track — draw your own path, tune Kp/Ki/Kd in real time.

robots.name: Object Detector
robots.description: Real-time DETR object detection from webcam — 80 object classes, Transformers.js, WebGPU.

robots.name: Depth Camera
robots.description: Monocular depth estimation — Depth Anything model estimates distance from single camera, 3 colormaps.

robots.name: DC Motor Controller
robots.description: PID-controlled DC motor driver for Arduino — speed control, direction, encoder feedback with wiring guide.
